business_premium.notes: Gaps in AU/IR controls. Not recommended for L3.

g3.notes: Good AU/IR coverage. Requires Defender and Purview add-on purchases.

g5.notes: All-inclusive. RECOMMENDED. Strongest coverage at lowest per-user cost.

assumptions: Client provides necessary access to all in-scope systems
Existing infrastructure documentation is current and accurate
Key stakeholders are available for interviews and validation

sow.statement_of_work: Implement and validate CMMC L2 compliance controls via harden_existing approach, including gap remediation, evidence collection, and assessment preparation.
deliverables: Implemented security controls per CMMC requirements
Evidence artifacts organized by control requirement
acceptance_criteria: Evidence artifacts verified against assessor requirements
customer_dependencies: Provide administrative access to in-scope systems
Designate compliance team points of contact
Make subject matter experts available for interviews
Approve configuration changes in a timely manner
